newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends down after new year-high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends down after new year-high.

text.p: Follow-through buying in newly-listed Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) led Jakarta's stock index to a new year-high in early trading on Tuesday but profit-taking subsequently surfaced, brokers said.
The index fell 2.01 points, or 0.32 percent, to close at 626.23 points after reaching a high of 631.64 points in early trade. Losers led gainers by 65 to 46, with 54 counters unchanged.
Brokers and analysts said the market was likely to gain on Wednesday with possible fresh buying of BNI and other issues after Tuesday's correction.
Market heavyweight Telkom is to announce nine-month results on Wednesday and brokers said they anticipated some positive news to emerge.
BNI, which was listed on Monday, topped the active list with 62.2 million shares traded, falling 100 rupiah to 1,150 on profit-taking, brokers said. They said some rises were likely on Wednesday.
"With the price lower than 1,200 rupiah, I guess many foreign investors are interested," a foreign broker said.
Timber firm Barito Pacific fell 200 rupiah to 1,575 on a volume of 23 million shares also on profit-taking.
Brokers said some investors cashed out of the share after it rose for the last two days on speculation that a prominent business group might take over the company.

Active buying on certain stocks such as Citra Marga, Indofood and Matahari prevented the index from falling further, they said. Toll-road operator Citra Marga rose 25 rupiah to 2,100 on a volume of 7.1 million on what brokers said was fresh buying on good fundamentals.
Noodles and seasoning manufacturer Indofood rose 75 rupiah to 5,075 rupiah on a volume of 3.5 million shares on talk of possible good nine-month results, brokers said.

Glass maker Asahimas fell 25 rupiah to 1,575 after reaching a high of 1,750 earlier on a turnover of 19 million shares. Brokers said it had risen on speculation that it had reached an agreement on prices with another manufacturer and later fell on profit-taking.
The index's previous year-high of 631.41 points was set in intra-day trade on April 23.
